book.name: Lapana Yane
book.title: LAPANA YANE Kataisato Jonenga Pii Lapana Yane Oko

content: Bapilone Tano Koya-kola, Wandakali-mane Epele Yaini Oko

Matili nambato ale ewa-kola, ati kenga kili kalae leane oko wandakali kambua-mane pii taimane lene gulea. Utupane-mane pii mindi leane oko loto, Bapilone tano oko pamuku wanda mindi gulo atoto, mana koo tupa minuto, yuu okona wandakali tupa minu koyoto, Gotena piape akali minditupa peyo ome leako leai. Goteto pamuku wanda andane okone yapa lo tale puato, mana koo okonena tene oko balanga yata wato, yole koo mindi bala maya. Wuaneko, Goteto mana epene tika-pene oko wato minuto, pii enene oko loto, wandakali yapa lo tale piyane lo nanimato andeyama. Andoto, nanimana Gote okomane nanima molo-peke leane nembo toto, nanimato balana gene oko laiyu loto, balanga tai-lene wete eya-kola, balana gene andane wete eya lamakale. Wandakali utupane-mane wuane leai.

Wuane lalu, utupane-mane pii pai pua teke taimane loto, Goteto Bapilone tano oko yangea-kola, ole dindi lo tano okone too atapo eya-kola, sia tua too atapowa atalane. Goteto wuane peane okonena, nanimato balana gene oko laiyu lo atamakale leai.

Wuane leai-kola, ando atalaini akali (24) paiyasa laponga tukumindi tupapi, minditaka saka atene tukumindi tupapi, utupane-mane tombawua lo atoto, kiŋi pitiyane toko okona peteane Gote oko lo lotu loto, enene, nanimato Gotena gene oko laiyu lamakale leai.

Wuane leai-kola, mindimane Gote pitiyane toko yane ongane mandaka atoto, pii mindi leane oko loto, Gotena piape wandakali gene yenepi, nayenepi, yakama pitaka-mane Gote yuku amawuato atoto, balana gene oko laiyu lo atalapape lea.
Sipisipi Andopane Oko Bala Wanda Kee Lolopeya Leane Oko

Balato wuane lea-angi, nambato ale ewa-kola, ipa andane mindi epo peakoto, oo lalane wuane pua teke wandakali kambua epo amunguli puato, pii taimane leaini oko ati kili-kulu taimane lene gulea. Utupane-mane pii mindi leaini oko loto, nanimana Akali Andane Gote tai wetete okomane wandakali pitaka bosa lo ando atalane loto, balana gene oko laiyu lamakale leai.

Gotena Sipisipi Andopane oko bala wanda kee lolane oto oko epea-kola, Goteto wanda okone bala kolosa epene ake-pene wete kalato natene tupa pua peteakale nembo tea. Wamba Gotena wandakali tupamane mana epene tika-pene tupa wato mineai-kola, yakamana mana utupane kolosa epene ake-pene wete gulea. Goteto kolosa epene wete ake-pene utupane wanda okone maya-kola, wanda okone bala Sipisipi Andopane okonena wetene gulo makande pea. Tene okonena, nanima mini epene palu atoto, epele wete wato, balana gene oko laiyu lo atamakale. Wandakali utupane-mane wuane leai.

Wuane leai-kola, enjole okomane namba languato, nimbato pepa mindi peyoto, wua lape: Sipisipi Andopane oko bala wanda okone kee lola-angi, Goteto tomo kambua yangola-kola, wandakali minditupa-mane tomo okone nolo polopeyai lea. Wamba Goteto wandakali utupane lamawuato, matili yakamato nambana tomo okone nolo ipulupale leane okonena, andipa wandakali utupane yakama epelewa atape-pene lo pepa peyape lea. Wuane lalu, balato pii utupane Gotena pii enene wete lea.

Wuane lea-kola, nambato bala lo lotu loyale, balana kene yane ongane aiki leka wato, tombawua lewa tekeko, balato namba languato, wamba Oli Sipitisa okomane potopesa akali tupa lamawuato, Jisasato wua pulupeya lo yakamato wandakali tupa lamai-yapape leane lea. Oli Sipitisa okomane wuane lea-kola, potopesa akali utupane-mane wuane leai. Andipa Oli Sipitisa okomane nimbapi, nimba towa piape mindiki piyaini amene tupapi, yakama languato, wamba Jisasato wua peane lo wandakali tupa lamauwa atalapape leya-kola, yakamato wuane lalaini leya. Namba yakama towa atu Gotena piape akali atoto, nanimato piape mindiki okone teke piyamane. Tene okonena, nimbato namba lo lotu nalene kondalu, Gote lo angu lotu lape. Enjole okonemane wuane lea.
Yia Osa Ake-pene Okona Masianesa Peteane Akali Oko

Okone angi, ati kenga okona asia lomba oko lumba-yene ya-kola, nambato akali mindi yia osa ake-pene mindina masianesa peteanga andewa. Wandakali-mane akali okone andayo pii mindi lalaini oko loto, akali okone balato pii enene loto, minditaka pukale lalane tupa enene piyane lalaini. Balato mana epene tika-pene tupa wato minu atoto, wandakali tupa yapa lo tale puato, akali koo tupa yanda pimawua atalane.

Balana lene okolapo ita lungu tene gulea-kola, balato kiŋi tupamane tangi anda piyaini okonetaka tupa kambua anda pitawa atea. Gene mindi balana umbaininga pepa peyatane ateane oko bala tane-mane angu nembo talane. Waka mindimane gene oko nembo natalane.
Wandakali-mane balana gene okone nembo natene ato, balana gene oko Gotena Pii Oko lalaini. Balana tonanga tundupa kambua pata atane atea.
Ati kenga atalaini ami tupamane tona kalato natene epene wete ake-pene tupa piyu, yia osa ake-pene tupana masianesa pituto, akali okone watama peai.

Aitene wandakali tupa yoko oyale kandepa nene atene mindi balana nee asianga apu latane atea. Balato utupane yokowa sia minuto, muli aene-mane waa-pene mindi auwa atoto, wandakali pitaka taimane bosa lo ando atolopeya. Ipane yoo penge lalaini yuli andane mindina getepe dini minditupa yola-kola, akali okonemane dini utupane balana kene-mane ango wato, utupanena ipane tupa penge lolopeya. Getepe ipane epola oko Gote tai-lene wetete okona yataka ene oko makande peya.

Akali okonena gene mindi kiŋi tupana kiŋi lalaini. Balana gene mindi akali andane tupana Akali Andane lalaini. Gene okonelapo balana tona okola, balana kene pelendene okola, okone-lapona pepa peyatane atea.

Okone angi, nambato andewa-kola, enjole mindi nai lene okona atea. Balato eka ati kenga yuu lo epoko pua ateaini tupa pitaka pii mindi taimane lamawuato, ami ando atalaini akali kawane tupapi, kiŋipi, akali tai tupapi, yia osapi, yia osa masianesa pitiyane akalipi, katapusa piape piyaini akalipi, mee anana atalaini akalipi, akali gene yenepi, nayenepi, akali yame utupanena kambua omolo-peyai lea. Omolai-kola, Goteto tomo andane mindi yakama gulupeya nembo toto, yakamato akali utupanena umbaini tupa namakale lo epo amunguli piyapape lea.

Enjole okonemane wuane lea-angi, nambato pusi kapua andane wetete okopi, yuu okona kiŋi tupapi, utupanena ami tupapi, utupane andewa. Utupane-mane yia osanga peteane akali tupapi, balana ami okopi, utupane yanda pimauyale epo amunguli pua ateai.

Wamba owato potopesa akali oko bala pusi kapua okona wenonga atoto, metekolo piape minditupa puato, wandakali minditupa minakasa ya-kola, mindimane pusi okonena gene oko makande puato, kokoli pitane namba (666) sikisa andete sikiti sikisa wandakali utupanena wenonenga pepa pelea. Wuane pea-kola, wandakali utupane-mane pusi kapua okone bala yale minditaka waa peaini okone lo lotu leai. Matili yia osanga peteane akali oko epea-angi, balato pusi kapua andane wete okola, balana owato potopesa akali okola, okonelapo andi lea. Okonelapo saka ateapi-kola teke, akali okonemane okonelapo andi lo auwa poto, ana gene salapa lene tupa ita-mane too nembeyawe pua atene yuli koo okona auwa aindaka lea.

Wuane piyu, yia osanga peteane akali okonemane kandepa luu nene atene mindi balana nee asianga apu latane ateane okomane kiŋi tupapi, utupanena ami tupapi, utupane yokowa ome lea. Omeai-kola, eka epeaini tupa pitaka-mane akali utupanena umbaini tupa no embo alu, ateai.
